search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.

Focused searches located official company disclosures and relevant industry reporting. The exact AI-server superlative remains undefined and unverified; further ranking claims without a disclosed basis would not resolve that scope gap.
The notebook ODM superlative is supported by Quanta's own undated marketing statement; it does not provide a dated, independently verifiable ranking methodology.
The AI-server “most important” superlative lacks a defined metric, period, market denominator, and company-specific comparative data in the reviewed sources.
